text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0713, Contract]
[OPERATIONS, SAFETY, AND CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE COMMITTEE MADE THE FOLLOWING RECOMMENDATION (5-0):]
AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer to award a five year firm fixed price Contract No. MA140717(2)000, to Kinkisharyo International LLC (KI), the lowest responsive and responsible proposer, in the Not-To-Exceed (NTE) amount of $962,985.60 for the purchase of 870 traction motor hardware kits to support the P3010 Light Rail Vehicle (LRV) fleet component overhaul, subject to the resolution of any properly submitted protest(s), if any.
.
